written_from_parent_concept.parent: google_compute_global_vm_extension_policy (rollout plans are real, but only documented as part of how global VM extension policies roll out changes)

intros.sourcing_notes: 71 of 95 resources map to their own real, specifically-documented concept page. 24 are real, narrower scopes of a documented parent -- almost entirely the region_*/zone_* pattern (a regional or zonal resource is, by Google's own documentation, explicitly the same real concept as its global counterpart, scoped narrower) -- sourced from that counterpart, not skipped. 0 genuine skips this provider. Real, verified finding: google_compute_rollout_plan initially looked like a possible skip (only a bare REST API listing turned up at first) -- a second, more targeted search found real explanatory content (rollout waves by zone/region for VM Extension Manager) before concluding it was undocumented, matching the ticket's own 'verified by looking, not assumed' bar. Several other resources (cross_site_network, wire_group, storage_pool, future_reservation, instance_group_manager_resize_request, global_vm_extension_policy, network_edge_security_service, region_composite_health_check/health_aggregation_policy/health_source, organization_security_policy) are genuinely recent GCP features verified live via WebSearch rather than assumed from general Compute Engine knowledge, the same discipline applied to Kubernetes's own newer APIs. No paid API used.

last_migration.stopped_at: Working against the real, live `ubx sdk gen --list-undescribed` gap list (26960 fields confirmed, matching Phase A's own count exactly) rather than the checked-in manifest snapshot, re-verified live this batch since the underlying schema is live-fetched and can drift between sessions. 10093 of 26960 gap fields (37.4%) now carry real source=ai description text, added in two ways: (1) 15 small product families -- agentregistry, apikeys, assuredworkloads, billingbudgets, cloudtasks, composer, datalineage, firebaserules, looker, modelarmor, secretmanager, securesourcemanager, servicedirectory, sourcerepo, workloadmanager -- fully completed, each individually live-verified (two-search minimum against the real API's own reference docs, e.g. docs.cloud.google.com/agent-registry, google.aip.dev) before writing, zero fields remaining in any of the 15; (2) a reusable common-field dictionary (`google.aip.dev`'s own standard cross-API field conventions -- AIP-122/132/148/154/155/216/217, live-fetched and grounded this batch -- plus a JSON-Schema-keyword set for Gemini's own embedded response-schema fields, plus per-family dictionaries built the same live-verified way for aiplatform/dlp/dialogflow/bigquery/run, the five single largest families) applied across 67 further families, each real and individually grounded but NOT exhaustive per family -- see per-family remainders below. 14 families with real gaps (beyondcorp, config, pubsub, dataform, developerconnect, lustre, memcache, cloudkms, artifactregistry, managedkafka, bigqueryconnection, firestore, storagebatchoperations, recaptchaenterprise -- 253 fields combined) got zero coverage this batch, none of their fields matched the common dictionaries; still fully open. The single largest remaining families by field count: google_dlp (1643 of 5366 remain), google_aiplatform (3255 of 5892 remain), google_dialogflow (1132 of 3240 remain), google_ces (602 of 929 remain), google_clouddeploy (857 of 901 remain), google_container (804 of 842 remain) -- clouddeploy/container got only the generic AIP sweep, no family-specific dictionary built yet, real next targets given their size. Azure's own 993-resource-type gap (69244 -> now 70585 fields, re-verified live and drifted up from Phase A's own snapshot by 1341 -- not yet reconciled, real, honest discrepancy) has zero AI-authored coverage yet, not started this batch. All 656 new GCP resource types (and Azure's 993) still need Phase B's real, live-researched intros -- explicitly held for after Phase C, per the founder's own instruction not to interleave the two.
